# Fixture Alpha

A listing that exists so the generator's presentation path has something to
read off disk.

## What it does

Nothing. It is a fixture. The prose is here because the generator inlines a
listing's README into the signed catalogue, and a no-network proof taken over a
listing with no README would have skipped the read entirely.

## Install

Not installable. Every artifact URL in this tree is on `example.invalid` and
every digest is a literal.

```sh
# not a real command
astra plugin install fixture-alpha
```
